prompt: Write a Solr q parameter using {!knn} to retrieve the top 100 most similar docs from field 'embedding' for the query vector [0.1, 0.2, 0.3]. One line.
notes: Basic kNN syntax: f=, topK=, vector after }

prompt: kNN search with topK=50 on field 'embedding' for vector [0.1, 0.2], pre-filtered (filter applied BEFORE HNSW traversal) by in_stock_b:true. One line q only.
notes: preFilter= integrates filter into HNSW traversal — preserves recall vs post-filter

prompt:
User reports that this query returns only 2-3 results, not the expected 50:
q={!knn f=embedding topK=50}[0.1, 0.2, 0.3]
fq=in_stock_b:true
(Their corpus has millions of docs, in_stock matches ~5%.) Explain in one sentence what's going wrong and write the corrected q line.
notes: fq runs as post-filter on the topK results; selective filter starves the result set

prompt: kNN with topK=100 on 'embedding' field, vector [0.1,0.2], pre-filtered by BOTH in_stock_b:true AND brand_s:Nike. Show one approach using comma-separated preFilter. One line.
notes: comma-separated preFilter string OR multiple preFilter= entries both work

prompt: Write the schema fieldType for a dense vector field with 768 dimensions using cosine similarity. Just the <fieldType> XML element.
What error happens when I query a 768-dim DenseVectorField with a 384-dim query vector? One short sentence.
notes: Dimension mismatch raises IllegalArgumentException at query time

prompt: Implement 'more like this' for document with id='p1': use its own embedding field value as the query vector. Top 10 similar docs. One line q only.
notes: field('embedding','p1') reads vector from doc p1 to use as query

prompt: I'm using similarityFunction=dot_product on my vector field but my embedding library returns unnormalized vectors. What's wrong with my similarity scores? One sentence + one-sentence fix.
notes: dot_product needs pre-normalized vectors; cosine handles normalization internally

prompt: Hybrid search: text query 'red shoes' via edismax (qf=title_t^5), then re-rank top 200 by kNN similarity to vector [0.1,0.2] (vector field 'embedding'), with reRankWeight=2.0. Show q, rq, and rqq parameters (one per line).
notes: Lexical retrieval + kNN re-rank is a common hybrid pattern

prompt: I want exactly 20 final results from kNN over an 'embedding' field with a fq=brand_s:Nike filter (Nike covers ~10% of corpus). Two-sentence approach: which mechanism + appropriate topK setting.
notes: Use preFilter so HNSW only considers matching docs; topK = desired_results × 2 minimum

prompt: Should I set stored=true on my DenseVectorField with 768 dimensions and 50M documents? One sentence.
notes: stored=true doubles disk usage; only set when you need fl=embedding to return vectors

prompt: I want kNN top 100 by similarity from 'embedding' but final ordering should be by price_f ascending (semantically nearest, then cheapest first). One line each: q, sort.
notes: Default sort is by score; override with sort= to reorder kNN topK

prompt: List the three similarityFunction options for DenseVectorField in Solr 9.x. Comma-separated, no other text.
